text:
Elaine (partnerships): Ok team — kickoff for the new 'ap-southeast-eco1' region with CloudWave. We need quota approvals, KMS enablement, and a joint launch runbook. Thoughts?
Marco (cloud-ops): Copy. I've got the initial quota CSV ready. Asking for 8x a100 + 20x t4s. Will open support ticket with infra.
CloudWave (partner): Thanks Elaine. We can pre-approve node images and provide our marketplace SKU. Need KMS access for HSM-backed keys; what's the target FIPS level?
Priya (eng-runtime): FIPS 140-2 level 2 minimum for customer keys. Also want to validate kernel config for our inference runtime (hugepage settings + isolcpus). Can we get a test pool?
Liam (sales): From GTM: can we aim for joint press week of May 11? Need marketing playbook + logo approvals.
Elaine (partnerships): May 11 is doable if engineering signoffs by Apr 28 and legal has logos by May 4. Marco — timeline for quota + test pool?
Marco (cloud-ops): I can get quota submitted today. Estimated approval 7-10 business days. For test pool, we can spin a 3-node validation cluster in our partner sandbox by Apr 20.
CloudWave (partner): We'll provide marketplace SKU and onboarding docs. For KMS, we'll need a service account with kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt and permissions to attach HSM keys. Sending IAM policy in a sec.
Priya (eng-runtime): Great — once test pool is up we need to run two smoke suites: 1) latency SLO synthetic (p50/p95 for 1k concurrent sessions) 2) quantized model accuracy baseline compare. I'll paste small run command we use: 
```
./run-smoke --target ap-southeast-eco1 --models gpt-small,gpt-quant --concurrency 1000 --duration 10m
```
Marco (cloud-ops): Noted. Also we need marketplace entitlement numbers for capacity gating. CloudWave — please confirm SKU entitlements (min units, burst available).
CloudWave (partner): SKU entitlements: base=50 units, burst=150 units for first 6 months. We'll set up marketplace entitlement mapping to our metering.
Elaine (partnerships): Legal note — we need logos + co-branding terms. @Liam can you chase legal? Also add a checklist for SOC2/PCI notes if any customers will be in finance.
Liam (sales): Looping in legal now. Will ping for logo approval and PR blurb by EOD.
Marco (cloud-ops): Quota ticket submitted: INC-87834. Attachments: quota.csv and topology.yml. Ticket ETA: 8 business days.
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline check — marketplace SKU package scanned (no vulnerabilities) and passed quick smoke.
Priya (eng-runtime): Once test cluster is live I'll run the smoke command and post results here. Also need a canary policy: if p95 > 800ms for 5m, auto-fallback to eu-west-1. Can we wire that into routing?
Marco (cloud-ops): Yes — routing policy exists. I'll add a route policy: region_fallback: eu-west-1, threshold_ms: 800, window: 300s.
CloudWave (partner): One more ask — for joint announcement, we need a 2-week embargo on partner marketing assets. Elaine ok?
Elaine (partnerships): Yes, 2-week embargo works. Add to runbook: embargo_start = May 1.
Priya (eng-runtime): Quick technical ask — can CloudWave enable debug logs for the first 48hrs with a limited retention? We need traces for regression monitoring.
CloudWave (partner): We can enable logs and push to shared bucket with lifecycle 30d. We'll send IAM on that too.
Elaine (partnerships): Recap action items: Marco -> quota ticket (INC-87834) + test cluster by Apr 20; CloudWave -> SKU entitlements + IAM policies + logs bucket; Priya -> smoke suites and canary config; Liam -> legal/logo/PR; Everyone -> review runbook by EOD Friday.
Priya (eng-runtime): I'll review runbook and add the smoke test section.
Marco (cloud-ops): Noted. Will update ticket with progress.
Liam (sales): Legal confirmed logo rights. PR draft expected by Apr 22.
CloudWave (partner): Sending SKU and IAM docs now. Expecting sandbox invite for test cluster.
Elaine (partnerships): Perfect. Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Marco (cloud-ops): small followup — adding sample quota payload for ticket: 
```json
{ "region": "ap-southeast-eco1", "resources": [{"type":"A100","count":8},{"type":"T4","count":20}], "reason": "partner launch" }
```
Priya (eng-runtime): Good. Once we have the pool creds I'll hand off results and a short runbook snippet for ops to run post-launch health checks.
deploy-bot: Reminder — schedule maintenance window for kernel tuning: May 3 02:00-04:00 UTC (pending approval).
Elaine (partnerships): Blocking items tracked. Will update central runbook as actions complete. Thanks!
